subject: general
question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '-' are interchanged and also '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

25 - 18 × 2 + 4 ÷ 7 = ?
solution:
Given 25 - 18 × 2 + 4 ÷ 7

After interchanging "+" & "-" and "×" & "÷"

25 + 18 ÷ 2 - 4 × 7

Using BODMAS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c476fe98f8dd5d9083758aa0a2a8f4b88fac12b6cc55d83ffbd650202486e2c0.png] 

⇒25 +**__18 ÷ ____2__** - 4 × 7

⇒25 + 9 - **__4 × 7__**

⇒__**25 + 9**__ - 28

⇒ 34 - 28

⇒6

Hence the correct option is "**Option 1"**
